standard-dialogue.npc: Why, hello there, young'un. Did my boy Percy say you could come up here?

standard-dialogue.player: Yes, I had to pay him to get access to this area.

standard-dialogue.npc: Ah, that's my Percy alright. I raised him well.

standard-dialogue-interacting-with-the-h.npc: I don't think you should be using that without speaking to Percy first.
